title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 10K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit 2pk
description: The Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Prefilled Pod Kit Twin Pack doubles the convenience and longevity of the standard setup. This set includes two complete devices, making it an excellent choice for vapers seeking extended use and exceptional value. Each individual kit features a 2ml prefilled pod and a dedicated 8ml auto-fill container. Once connected, the container automatically feeds the pod, providing a seamless experience and up to 10,000 puffs per device (up to 20,000 puffs combined), depending on individual usage. Powered by a substantial 1000mAh built-in battery with USB-C charging, each Dojo Blast 10K device is designed for reliable performance with minimal downtime. The kits utilise Vaporesso's COREX 2.0 technology and dual mesh coils, ensuring consistent flavour delivery and satisfying vapour production from the first draw to the last. Tailored for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, the inhale-activated draw closely replicates the familiar sensation of a traditional cigarette. The transparent pod design allows you to monitor e-liquid levels at a glance, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system efficiently saturates the coil to help prevent dry hits. With no buttons to press or complex menus to navigate, setup is effortless—simply attach the prefilled components and inhale to vape. This TPD-compliant twin pack is a closed system requiring no messy maintenance, available in a selection of popular 20mg nicotine salt Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K 2-Pack Kit Flavours • Straw-Raspberry Cherry Ice An indulgent trio of Strawberry, Raspberry and Cherry layered with a brisk Menthol finish for a punchy yet juicy fruit vape. • Pineapple Ice Juicy, tangy Pineapple takes centre stage with tropical sweetness and a cool, breezy Menthol exhale. • Fizzy Cherry Rich Cherry notes lifted with a subtle sparkling twist for a sweet yet punchy vape with a gentle fizz. • Blueberry Sour Raspberry Sweet Blueberry meets tart Raspberry in this tangy fruit blend with a playful sour edge. • Blue Razz Lemonade A juicy blend of Blue Raspberry and Lemonade offering deep berry and zingy citrus layers with a bright finish.
